known.zero_call_empty_control: U7; all three outcomes reported; saved controls use original receipts
known.v1.1_pairing: Descriptive on common available pairs, with availability transitions and all eligible-case scores separately

fresh.count_gate_conversion: Use the frozen rates directly: available/5 >= 10/11 and material/5 <= 2/11, separately for each defect. This is 5/5 and 0/5 at this sample size.

missing_scores: NA for empty-control, execution-failed and not-run outcomes; eligible abstentions receive their 1–5 scores; all eligible outcomes count toward availability
stop_rule: One execution, at most 16 attempted translations, no retries, replacements, repairs or critic API calls. No further optimization after this validation.
